mostWorthwhile.text: Matching the notice to the rack was worthwhile: it showed how to remove the leased modem's authority over the door while retaining its uplink.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the selector twice before its prerequisites were ready was repetitive, especially after the first attempt said it had no available operation.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the locally addressed rack had no available partners; the fobs had to be enrolled on the portable controller separately.

arbitrary.text: The need to pair the fobs with the selector before fitting it to the rack was not obvious to me, though the feedback made the sequence clear.

continue.text: I would continue: separating ownership, authorization and connectivity made the infrastructure problem interesting, and the shared controls gave the repair a meaningful outcome despite the frustrating prerequisite search.
